## Format Notes

- Pokemon Champions VGC 2026 Tournaments is currently led by Kingambit at 35.59% usage. The top of the usage chart also includes Kingambit, Garchomp, Incineroar, Basculegion, and Charizard-Mega-Y.
- The most common two-Pokemon core is Charizard-Mega-Y, and Garchomp, appearing on 2155 teams (16.3% of the sampled field).
- The top three-Pokemon core is Charizard-Mega-Y, Garchomp, and Kingambit, which highlights one of the most repeated structures in the format.
- The current featured top team is from shaikhvgc786 at 13-2.
